descriptionChirho: Hifil stem of עָרַךְ used in Levitical legislation for the priestly act of setting a monetary valuation on persons, animals, or property dedicated to YHWH (Lev 27). All six occurrences share the same Hifil causative sense of assigning economic worth. Spanish 'valuará/tasó' (will value/assessed), Hindi 'मूल्यांकन करेगा/आँका' (mūlyāṅkan karegā/ānkā, will evaluate/estimated), Arabic 'يُقَوِّمُ/قَوَّمَ' (yuqawwimu/qawwama, appraises/appraised), Korean '값을 매길 것이다/평가하였다' (gapseul maegil geosida/pyeong-gahayeotda, will set price/evaluated), Swahili 'atamthaminisha/aliipima' (will cause-to-value/measured).
